definition.vastlint: load call yields at least one resolved InLine ad (gate2.mjs rule)
definition.rmpvast: an ad started (rmp-vast adstarted event) under window.VASTCONF.run('rmpvast', url, {timeout:3000}, {kind:'full'})

rmpvast.notCompleteReason: NonLinear overlay ads have no complete event; each started (adimpression, adstarted, adcreativeview) and was destroyed when the harness ended the run after 60 s

agreement: started/resolved InLine Ad id equals stored vast-client-js 6.5.0 resolved Ad id (results/iab-samples/node/results.jsonl) for all 49 samples, for both vastlint and rmp-vast

media.note: IAB sample MediaFiles (video/mp4 on iab-publicfiles.s3.amazonaws.com and cdn.iabcdn.com) answered by the runner with the harness 10-second ad (code/harness/browser/media/ad-10s.webm) remuxed to MP4 without re-encoding (VP9/Opus), since Playwright Chromium has no H.264 decoder
